title: U.S. partners with Westinghouse on $80B+ of new reactors

sources.publisher: Brookfield Asset Management Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
sources.quote: At the center of the new strategic partnership, at least $80 billion of new reactors will be constructed across the United States using Westinghouse nuclear reactor technology.

explain: The U.S. government signed a partnership with Westinghouse and its owners Brookfield and Cameco to get at least $80 billion of new Westinghouse nuclear reactors built in the U.S. The $80 billion is the headline value of reactors to be built, not cash already paid by the government; how much public money flows, and when, depends on later project deals.
